about: A different job the fine-tune never trained on: is this review positive, negative or mixed? 12 synthetic reviews (8 English, 4 Thai), hand-labelled on 2026-10-17. Lab 17-6 asks the base and the fine-tuned models the same question, to see whether specialising on tickets broke a general skill (catastrophic forgetting).

question.instructions: What is the overall sentiment of `message`?

criteria.mixed: clearly both good and bad points

items.text: Fantastic breakfast and the staff remembered our names. Would come back tomorrow.
items.label: positive

items.text: The room was dirty, the Wi-Fi never worked and nobody answered the phone.
items.label: negative

items.text: Best sleep I've had in months, the bed is incredible.

items.text: Overpriced and the food arrived cold twice.
items.label: negative

items.text: Lovely view and friendly reception, though checkout took forty minutes.

items.text: Absolutely spotless, quiet and close to the station. Perfect for work trips.
